Sheet-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken Thighs

One pan, forty-five minutes, and the potatoes soak up everything the chicken gives off. Bone-in thighs stay juicy at high heat, so there is no need to babysit them.

Sheet-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken Thighs

Ingredients

  • 8 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs (about 2 1/2 lb)
  • 1 1/2 lb baby potatoes, halved
  • 3 Tbsp olive oil
  • 6 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1 lemon, zested and juiced
  • 1 tsp dried oregano
  • 1 tsp kosher salt
  • 1/2 tsp black pepper
  • 2 Tbsp chopped parsley

Instructions

  1. Heat the oven to 425°F and line a rimmed sheet pan with foil.
  2. Toss the potatoes with 1 Tbsp of the olive oil and half the salt, and spread them on the pan.
  3. Stir the rest of the oil with the garlic, lemon zest and juice, oregano, the rest of the salt and the pepper. Rub it over the chicken.
  4. Nestle the thighs skin side up among the potatoes and roast 35 minutes, until the skin is crisp and the thighs reach 175°F.
  5. Scatter with parsley and serve from the pan.
